protocol.stages: hold session, catalog and history separately; metadata delayed 2200ms; settle fonts and 1000ms after models
protocol.cls: maximum session window, gap <1000ms and length <5000ms; excludes recent input
protocol.panelFrames: candidate native workbench rectangle sampled on animation frames; <=1 CSS px movement required

scope: Fully styled synthetic CSR workspace; held auth, catalog and stream requests; metadata delayed 2200ms. Local Chrome, no field percentile or production latency claim. The baseline UI is archived from the base commit with the same fixture corrections. Root entry first returned a fixture 404; that failed attempt is excluded. Twelve valid non-root cases were retained and three final cases resumed after the root-path guard was corrected. One accepted run per viewport/route combination; no percentile estimate. The 640x450 DPR2 case approximates reflow at 200 percent zoom, without literal browser zoom.
